intro: This is your complete guide to managing members in the RWB App.
list: RWB has one master member list.
The app shows it, and our Google Sheet keeps a copy.
They stay in sync both ways. Change one, and the other updates by itself.
join: New riders join in two ways: the join form on our website, or straight from the app.
The app's join form is exactly the same as the Google Form, with the same questions and the same Terms and Conditions.
Either way, nobody becomes a member straight away.
Every new entry waits in the Approvals list, and admins get a notification.
appadmin: As an admin, you'll find an Admin card right on your Home screen.
Orange badges show what's waiting. Tap Approvals to open the list.
checks: One. Is this a new member, or an existing one?
Two. Do they own a Ronin?
Four. Did they agree to the Terms and Conditions?
app4checks: Here's a new rider, with three out of four. The VRN still needs checking.
And here's an existing member who signed in on the app. Their VRN and Terms were verified earlier, so they pass all four checks.
vrn: Checking a VRN is done by you, the admin.
Copy the number, and check it on Parivahan, or with the rider.
If another member already has the same VRN, the card warns you.
appapprove: Tick VRN verified, and tap Approve.
Right away, a ready message pops up, welcoming them, and telling them we'll add them to the WhatsApp group within seventy-two hours.
Tap Send on WhatsApp. It goes from your own WhatsApp, so it's completely free.
msgs: There's a ready message for every situation.
A warm welcome for new members.
A friendly note for existing members, with a quick guide to the app.
And a polite message, with the reason, if you have to say no.
You can edit any message before sending.
appexisting: For an existing member, the message says they're already in our group, explains the app's features, and asks them to update their profile.
appreject: If something isn't right, tap Reject, and pick a reason.
A polite message is ready to send, and their sheet row moves to the Rejected tab.
changes: Members can update their own details in the app.
But important changes come to you first: name, WhatsApp number, main bike and VRN, a new bike, or withdrawing from the Terms and Conditions.
appchanges: Changes appear below the new entries, showing the old and the new value.
Verify the VRN, approve, and let them know on WhatsApp if you like.
appshare: Want the other admins to know? Tap Share this list, and send a summary to the admin WhatsApp group in one tap.
followups: Some older members never agreed to the Terms and Conditions, and some have details missing, like an emergency contact.
Members on the app are reminded automatically every Sunday.
For everyone else, one tap sends a ready reminder on WhatsApp.
appfollow: Open Follow-ups at the bottom of Approvals.
Tap WhatsApp to remind someone, or Agreed if they confirmed to you.
You can also send in-app reminders right now.
sheet: In the Google Sheet, the App Status column keeps track.
New entries show Waiting for approval.
Rejected rows move to the Rejected tab, and old duplicates move to Older entries.
appnew: Every week, open the RWB tab and tap New.
Tap a member, verify their bikes, and add them to the WhatsApp group.
results: When someone leaves, here's what happens.
They disappear from the member list.
Their app login and data are deleted.
Their sheet row moves to Removed members.
And admins can still see them, under Left or removed.
appremove: Open their profile, tap Remove from RWB, pick a reason, add a note, and confirm.
Removed someone by mistake? Open Left or removed, and tap Restore.
appmembers: A card on Home asks them to agree to the Terms and Conditions, or complete their profile.
They read the Terms, and tap I agree.
And when they change their name, it's sent to you for approval.
appjoin: And new riders see the same join form as our website, starting with the Terms and Conditions.
donts: Deleting a row in the sheet by hand does not remove anyone.
And uninstalling the app does not remove anyone either.
Always use the Remove from RWB button.
rules: To sum up, five simple habits.
One. Check the Approvals list every day, and approve at four out of four.
Two. Always send the ready WhatsApp message.
Three. Share the list with the admin group when needed.
Four. Every week, add new members to WhatsApp, and clear your follow-ups.
Five. Remove members only with the Remove from RWB button.
outro: Thank you for looking after our warriors.
